# Exhibition plan

The harbour archive is a six-month exhibition project built around recorded accounts of the waterfront. The immediate jobs are recording consent, returning extracts to speakers, drafting labels and arranging a withdrawal contact. The opening is scheduled for June. The size of the exhibition should follow what speakers are willing to share, rather than making consent fit the number of panels already ordered.

The registrar will receive the final recordings and permission table. We still need to agree who can remove a printed extract after opening, and how quickly the request should be acted on. [[Listening]] records the interview approach. [[Field methods]] holds the exclusions log and the distinction between a selected set of interviews and a representative account of the harbour.
